# Test and lint tooling for ci_code_checks.yml. Separate from
# requirements.txt because the pipeline itself never needs these -- the
# convert/deploy/verify jobs would only be paying to install them.
#
# Pinned for the same reason the toolchain is: an unpinned linter changes the
# rules under you. A new ruff release that adds a check to the "F" set turns
# an unrelated pull request red, which is how a gate loses its credibility.
# Bumping these is a deliberate act with its own diff.

pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.16.4

# zoneinfo (used by scripts/convert/sigma_to_spl.py for Europe/Budapest)
# relies on the IANA tzdata being available somewhere. Linux distros and CI
# runners ship it at the OS level, but Windows does not, so without this
# package a developer running on Windows gets
# "ZoneInfo: No time zone found with key Europe/Budapest" locally while CI
# stays green -- a divergence that teaches people the local suite is
# "supposed" to be red. tzdata's stdlib backport picks the OS copy first and
# only falls back to this one, so pinning it here is a no-op on platforms
# that already have it.
tzdata==2026.3
